problem: A bookshelf plate rising edge was consumed before the turn finished moving the cart/statue. The final sweep could be empty while the pressed plate could no longer request the missed rotation.
fix: Keep blocked bookshelf requests per plate/shelf pair during the current input and recheck them when linked device states refresh after movement.
Always recheck the actual current footprint: a statue or other physical obstacle still in the sweep continues to block rotation.
Remove each request on successful rotation or plate release. Expire remaining requests at input completion, so a held plate does not fire a stale press on a later turn.
Keep the existing event, animation-direction selection, cost, Undo and input-blocking policies.
coverage: Two tests failed before the fix: the exact ET-12 cart-departure input path and a locked charging statue clearing the swept corner after the plate press.
ET-12 is also replayed through the actual PuzzlePrototypeController in PlayMode; the shelf reaches vertical with no missing bindings and input cost 16.
All poses and rotation directions allow statues outside the selected sweep. A continuously held plate does not replay an expired blocked press.
Existing statue charging, player contact and glass-break tests pass.
existingChanges: The initial git-status snapshot is preserved; only three task source files and this validation folder were added.
